description: COLUMBUS—State Senator Al Cutrona (R-Canfield) was sworn into the Ohio Senate yesterday. Senator Cutrona will serve the people of Ohio's 33rd Senate District after his predecessor Michael Rulli was elected to serve Ohio's 6th Congressional District.“I’m grateful for the opportunity to serve in the Upper Chamber for the constituents of the 33rd Senate District," said Cutrona. title: Cutrona Takes Office as Ohio State Senator
